text: With probes at every 500-step checkpoint for the 6-layer d_model=128 model at e <= 0.85, does accel_step R2 at layer 6 level off near 0.70 by step 1500-2000 while val_mse_ratio keeps falling from 0.05 to 0.0035? A plateau in the same seed would show that linear decodability of accel_step has decoupled from prediction quality at high eccentricity.
